def q(tag):

def normalize(s):

def col_to_num(col):
    n = 0
    for ch in col:
        n = n * 26 + (ord(ch.upper()) - ord("A") + 1)

def split_cell_ref(ref):

    if cell is None:
        return None
    t = cell.get("t")
    if t == "s":
        v = cell.find(q("v"))
        if v is None or v.text is None:
            return None
        return shared_texts[int(v.text)]
    if t == "inlineStr":
        is_elem = cell.find(q("is"))
        if is_elem is None:
            return None
        return "".join((txt.text or "") for txt in is_elem.iter(q("t")))
    v = cell.find(q("v"))
    return v.text if v is not None else None

def set_inline_string(cell, value):
    # Remove existing value/formula/inline string children but preserve cell attributes such as style.
    for child in list(cell):
        if child.tag in {q("v"), q("f"), q("is")}:
            cell.remove(child)
    cell.set("t", "inlineStr")
    is_elem = ET.SubElement(cell, q("is"))
    t_elem = ET.SubElement(is_elem, q("t"))
    if value == " " or str(value).startswith(" ") or str(value).endswith(" "):

    t_elem.text = str(value)
